title: SpargeOutput
description: Sparge plan: how the sparge water is split and how hot to heat it.

runs.description: Number of equal sparge runs. 1 for fly sparge, 0 when there is no sparge water.

water_temp_c.description: Temperature to heat the (first run of) sparge water to, in °C. Capped at 95 °C.

next_runs_water_temp_c.description: Temperature for the runs after the first, in °C: the bed is already at the target, so they go in at the target temperature.
